core_capabilities: Discover events by category or search by artist, location, and date range.
Narrow an artist's concert listings by artist text, location, date range, and date presets.
Choose ticket quantities or individual seats, compare their prices and availability, and build or revise a cart.
Enter purchaser and payment information, review charges, and optionally add ticket insurance.
Place an in-app simulated order and review its event, ticket, seat, insurance, and price confirmation.
secondary_capabilities: Print or save a detailed order confirmation through the browser print dialog.

app.description: Discover concert events, choose tickets or seats, and complete an in-app simulated ticket purchase.
